questions.solution: (a) Relative height of 7 m. As per the reference image.

questions.solution: (b) Cart track. Single red lines on the topographical map indicate cart tracks.

questions.question: Refer to the image (toposheet extract) and answer: What is the main occupation of the people living in the area shown on the eastern part?
questions.solution: (c) Forestry. Green colour on the topographical map indicates forest region.

questions.question: Refer to the image (toposheet extract) and answer: What is the social significance of Idarla?

options.a: Idarla is larger than other settlements.

questions.solution: (c) Annual fair at Idarla.. As per the reference image.
questions.figure_desc: Toposheet extract showing the settlement Idarla.

questions.question: Refer to the image (toposheet extract) and answer: What does the number 200 in grid square 4932 represent?
questions.solution: (c) Contour height.. A contour line shows places of equal height; contour lines represent height and slope of the landform.
questions.figure_desc: Toposheet extract; grid square 4932 shows the number 200.

concepts: area calculation from grid squares and scale
questions.question: Refer to the image (toposheet extract) and answer: With reference to the scale given in topographical map (2cm=1km), what is the area of the land enclosed between 48 to 50 easting and 28 to 31 northings?
questions.solution: (b) 06 sq. km.. As per the reference image (3 km x 2 km = 6 sq. km).
questions.figure_desc: Toposheet extract with grid lines (eastings 48-50, northings 28-31) and scale 2 cm = 1 km.

questions.question: What does nearness of contour lines indicate?
questions.solution: (a) It indicates steep slope.. Closely drawn contour lines indicate steep slope.

questions.question: Which scale out of the following, that is printed on the topographical map, is considered a special scale?
questions.solution: (b) Representative fraction.. Representative fraction (RF) is the ratio of map distance to ground distance, printed at the bottom of the topographic map.

questions.question: With reference to winter rain in India answer the following: (i) Western disturbances provide rain to which of the following States?
questions.solution: (a) Punjab. Punjab receives winter rain due to western disturbances.

concepts: retreating monsoon rain on the Coromandel Coast
questions.question: With reference to winter rain in India answer the following: (ii) Which of the following cause rain to Coromandel Coast?
questions.solution: (a) Retreating monsoons. The retreating (S.E.) monsoon brings rain to the Coromandel Coast, especially Tamil Nadu.

questions.question: Westerly depressions are active in India during which of the following months?
questions.solution: (b) Between December and January. Westerly depressions are active in India between December and January.

concepts: annual range of temperature from data
questions.question:
Study the following data and answer the questions that follow:
MONTH: JAN FEB MAR APR MAY JUN JULY AUG SEP OCT NOV DEC
TEMP (°C): 23.1 24.8 26.5 29.3 32 32.8 33.1 32.1 30.5 29.3 28.7 26.1
RAIN (cm): 15.3 10.1 0.3 0.1 1.3 4.5 6.1 10.2 10.5 20.1 16.8 19.0
(i) What is the annual range of temperature experienced by the station?
questions.solution: (b) 10°C. Annual range = 33.1 - 23.1 = 10 deg C.

concepts: reading rainfall data for the driest month
questions.question:
Study the following data and answer the questions that follow:
MONTH: JAN FEB MAR APR MAY JUN JULY AUG SEP OCT NOV DEC
TEMP (°C): 23.1 24.8 26.5 29.3 32 32.8 33.1 32.1 30.5 29.3 28.7 26.1
RAIN (cm): 15.3 10.1 0.3 0.1 1.3 4.5 6.1 10.2 10.5 20.1 16.8 19.0
(ii) Which according to the given data is the driest month?
questions.solution: (b) April. April has the least rain (0.1 cm).

concepts: rain shadow of the Western Ghats
questions.question: Why is the central part of Deccan plateau a dry area?

options.a: It is away from the sea
options.b: There is no barrier in the part of rain bearing wind
options.c: It is due to jet Streams
options.d: It is a rain shadow area of Western Ghats

questions.solution: (d) It is a rain shadow area of Western Ghats. Western Ghats block moisture from the south-west monsoon, creating a rain shadow over the Deccan plateau.

concepts: Bay of Bengal branch of monsoon
rainfall decrease from east to west in the Ganga plain
questions.question: Why does Patna get more rain than Agra during the summer monsoon season?

options.b: Patna is on western side so Arabian sea branch brings more rain to it than to Agra
options.c: Patna is on eastern side, so Bay of Bengal branch brings more rain to it than to Agra
options.d: Patna gets rain throughout the year.

questions.solution: (c) Patna is on eastern side, so Bay of Bengal branch brings more rain to it than to Agra. Patna lies in the lower Ganga valley, east of Agra, and gets more rain from the Bay of Bengal branch.

questions.question: Which of the statement is not correct for Indian monsoon?

options.c: Most of the rain is in winter time
options.d: Most of the rain is orographic or relief type.

questions.solution: (c) Most of the rain is in winter time. Indian monsoon is erratic, seasonal and mostly orographic; there is little or no rain in winter.

concepts: soil conservation: terrace farming against water erosion
questions.question: With reference to methods of prevention of soil erosion answer the following: (i) Name the method used to prevent soil erosion by running water.
questions.solution: (a) Terrace farming. Terrace farming prevents washing away of soil by running water.

concepts: shelter belts/strip cropping against wind erosion
questions.question: With reference to methods of prevention of soil erosion answer the following: (ii) Name the method used to prevent soil erosion by wind.
questions.solution: (b) Strip cropping. Strip cropping prevents soil erosion especially by wind.

concepts: black soil distribution in the Deccan
questions.question: (i) Name the soil that is found in central Deccan plateau?
questions.solution: (a) Black soil. Black soil is found in the central Deccan plateau.

concepts: formation of black soil from lava
questions.question: (ii) How is the soil named by you in (i) above formed? (soil named in (i): the soil found in central Deccan plateau)

options.a: Formed by the deposition of silt brought down by river.
options.b: Formed by the weathering of lateritic rocks.
options.c: Formed by the weathering of basic lava rocks.
options.d: Formed by the weathering of metamorphic rocks.

questions.solution: (c) Formed by the weathering of basic lava rocks.. Black soil is formed by weathering of igneous (basic lava) rocks.

questions.question: Why is laterite soil used in Goa and Kerala for the construction of houses?

options.b: This soil is generally coarse in texture and porous in nature.
options.c: It has more of clay content in it.
options.d: It looks beautiful when used in buildings.

questions.solution: (a) It become hard when dry.. Laterite hardens irreversibly on exposure to air.

concepts: deforestation causing erosion in the Himalayan foothills
questions.question: Why are the foothills of Himalayas prone to excessive soil erosion?

options.b: Too much of development of transportation.
options.d: Tourists are spreading pollutants in rivers.

questions.solution: (c) Large scale deforestation in past. Large scale deforestation in the past left the foothills with little vegetation.

questions.question: Name the soil that possesses the following characteristics: (i) Soil is generally confined to river basins.
questions.solution: (b) Alluvial soil. Alluvial soil is confined to river basins.

questions.question: Name the soil that possesses the following characteristics: (ii) Soil that becomes infertile because of desilication.
questions.solution: (d) Laterite soil. Laterite soil becomes infertile because of desilication.

questions.question: The productive functions of forests include:

options.c: Provide various products such as timber, fuel wood, leaves, etc.

questions.solution: (c) Provide various products such as timber, fuel wood, leaves, etc.. Productive functions: timber, fuel wood, leaves and other products.

concepts: forest types and their characteristic species
questions.question: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
questions.solution: (b) Sandalwood-Tropical deciduous forest. Sandalwood is found in tropical deciduous forests.

concepts: tropical evergreen forests on the Western Ghats windward side
questions.question: Name the type of Natural Vegetation that is found in the windward side of the Western Ghats:
questions.solution: (a) Tropical Evergreen. Tropical evergreen forests are found on the windward side of the Western Ghats.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of desert vegetation?
questions.solution: (c) Broad leaves. Broad leaves increase transpiration, so they are not a desert plant characteristic.

concepts: need for forest conservation and ecological balance
questions.question: Why do we need forest conservation?

options.a: Forests provide food for growing population.
options.b: Forests helps in earning foreign exchange.
options.c: Forests help in maintaining ecological balance.

questions.solution: (c) Forests help in maintaining ecological balance.. Forests maintain ecological balance.

questions.question: During which month do we celebrate VAN MAHOTSAV every year in India?

options.a: In December to February time period
options.b: In July to September time period
options.c: In March to May time period
options.d: In November to January time period

questions.solution: (b) In July to September time period. Van Mahotsav is celebrated from 1 to 7 July.

questions.question: What is the term used to describe the growing of trees in various parts of the country?
questions.solution: (d) Afforestation.. Afforestation is establishing forest where there was no previous tree cover.

questions.question: Why is there a need to conserve water in India?

options.a: A lot of water is polluted
options.b: No water is found below the land in India
options.c: Water is in abundance in India
options.d: We receive lot of rain in summer

questions.solution: (a) A lot of water is polluted. Water quality is badly affected by urban wastes, industrial effluents, pesticides and fertilizers.

questions.question: What are the advantage of rain water harvesting?

options.a: Recharge of ground water and conservation of water.
options.b: Provide water through canals to the farms and its conservation
options.c: It helps in harvesting of crops and its storage
options.d: Provide water for multinational companies to produce packaged drinking water.

questions.solution: (a) Recharge of ground water and conservation of water.. Rainwater harvesting recharges groundwater and conserves water.

concepts: canal irrigation in the Northern Plains
questions.question: Why is canal irrigation more popular in Northern Plains?

options.a: The surface of land is almost flat and soft soil is easy to dig.
options.b: To supply water to a number of cities in the plain area.
options.c: Rocky surface of the plain help in their construction.
options.d: Rivers are seasonal and so canals are needed.

questions.solution: (a) The surface of land is almost flat and soft soil is easy to dig.. The northern plains are flat with soft soil, suitable for canals.

concepts: irrigation method by state: wells, tube wells, tanks, canals
questions.question: Which of the following is correctly matched?
questions.solution: (c) Lined well — Uttar pradesh. North India has alluvial soil and shallow groundwater suitable for wells.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a suitable condition for the development of tank irrigation?

options.c: Plenty of rain in rainy period.

questions.solution: (b) Permeable rock structure.. Tank irrigation needs hard, impervious rock below so water does not seep in.

questions.question: Which among the following is a ground water source?
questions.solution: (a) Spring. Springs and wells are groundwater sources.

questions.question: What is the importance of "DRIP IRRIGATION"?

options.a: It is an ultra-modern system of irrigation.
options.b: It is cheaper than other sources.
options.c: It can irrigate more area with less usage of water.
options.d: It is used by almost all farmers in India.

questions.solution: (c) It can irrigate more area with less usage of water.. Drip irrigation delivers water directly to the root zone, irrigating more area with less water.
